name: Diggnation
summary: Diggnation is back! Kevin Rose and Alex Albrecht give you their unique, sometimes awkward, and always hilarious take on the edges of the internet. Diggnation is a tech/web culture show based on the top digg.com social bookmarking news stories.

previousepisode.name: Is College Still Worth It When Entry-Level Jobs Are Disappearing?

name: Солнечный зайчик
summary: The story of the life and sincere love of a real woman. The story begins with the twenty-year-old age of the main character, Irina. Then a great feeling settled in her kind heart, which she carried through many years of living together with her lover, who became Irina's husband. But time becomes a test for love, and not every man is able to appreciate devotion.

name: The Mole Sisters
summary: The Mole Sisters, based on the book series by Canadian Roslyn Schwartz, follows two mole sisters on their gentle adventures as they explore their environment. Independent, curious and full of energy, the sisters bring optimism and delight to their daily routine, whether rolling down hills, swinging on willow trees or splashing in the mud.

previousepisode.name: The Mole Sisters and The Busy Bees

name: Tiny Planets
summary: Bing and Bong are two adorable and strange white woolly creatures who roam the universe on a funny and practical sofa.

name: Tamagotchi
summary: The series follows the adventures of a group of teenage Tamagotchi characters who live on the planet Tamagotchi. The characters attend school, work part-time jobs, and hang out with their friends.

name: The Connor and Sparky SHow
summary: The Connor and Sparky Show chronicles the daily lives of Connor, Sparky, Tabitha, and Cindy - a ragtag group of kids with mismatched personalities. They have adventures/misadventures and go through their everyday struggles around their hometown of Oaksdale. The episodes revolve around Connor and his friends as they interact with other Oaksdale residents and their families and live out their day-to-day adventures, often getting caught up in various predicaments.

previousepisode.name: It Came from Outer Space: Part 2

name: Kabul
summary:
Six-part English-language drama recalling the events of August 15, 2021, when the American troops withdrew from Afghanistan, through the eyes of an Afghani family. 

As American troops withdraw, the Taliban enter Kabul. The Nazany family is forced to flee the country, like many civilians, for fear of reprisals. In this desperate and chaotic situation, looming over by the threat of an attack by the Islamic State, French police, Italian diplomats, German military personnel, and American intelligence services must somehow coordinate to manage the influx of civilians. How will each of them manage to save their lives? The countdown has begun.

name: Prost
summary: The career of Alain Prost, four-time Formula 1 world champion and winner of 51 races, undoubtedly the greatest and best French racing driver in the history of F1.

name: Blood of the Irish
summary: The second and concluding programme in Diarmuid Gavin's global journey to find out where we came from...

name: Ivan Milat: Buried Secrets
summary: 7News presents a ground-breaking true crime series revealing new evidence that Australia's most notorious serial killer may have been responsible for more murders beyond the Belanglo Seven.

name: The Hunger: The Story of the Irish Famine
summary: Liam Neeson narrates this two-part documentary marking the 175th anniversary of The famine, exploring the international origins, development and legacy.

name: City Wildlife Rescue
summary: For the dedicated staff at the Toronto Wildlife Center, caring for an ill or injured animal and returning them to their natural habitat as soon as possible is its own reward. Watch as their amazing stories of compassion and triumph unfold.

name: Reborn in Vengeance
summary: Lu Ning'an, a young widow, toiled tirelessly for her deceased husband Xie Yunwang's family and helped her stepson Xie Zichen achieve success and fame. Yet, on her deathbed, she uncovered the shocking truth: Xie Yunwang had faked his death, his mistress Lin Wan'er flaunted her arrogance, and Xie Zichen's loyalty was a lie. Reborn into her past life, Lu Ning'an now wields unwavering resilience. She battles treacherous men, outsmarts scheming rivals, and dismantles the corrupt Xie family, forging a path of self-redemption and empowerment.

name: Ballard
summary: Detective Renée Ballard is tasked with running the LAPD's new cold case division—a poorly funded, all-volunteer unit with the largest case load in the city. Ballard approaches these frozen-in-time cases with empathy and determination. When she uncovers a larger conspiracy during her investigations, she'll lean on the assistance of her retired ally, Harry Bosch, to navigate the dangers that threaten both her unit and her life.

name: American Muscle Car
summary: The American Muscle Car series relives that incredible time when Detroit produced the most outrageous cars ever to hit the street.

name: Rent a Boss to Go Home for Chinese New Year
Oops, I Gave Birth to the Emperor's Twins!
summary: A brilliant, never-married genius with seven doctoral degrees is transported to another world, where she gives birth to twins. She discovers she's the deposed Empress of Yan, and their father is the Emperor. Using her adorable children, she leads him into a desperate pursuit, making him regret everything.

name: La maison de Toutou
summary: Toutou and Zouzou live peacefully in their small house in the countryside, bickering occasionally. Toutou is a gardener, a patriarch, and a bit of a grump. Zouzou is a clever and sometimes mocking indoor cat, who knows how to make herself heard despite her very small voice. One morning, Toutou and Zouzou meet their new neighbour, Kiki. She's a flirtatious and curious frog who works in the weather forecast. The three of them will quickly become the best of friends!

name: Bloody Tales of Europe
summary: From ancient times to the Second World War, Europe has been soaked in blood and intrigue. In this fascinating new series, Bloody Tales goes beyond the British Isles to seek out the Europe's most grisly history to discover the mysterious true stories behind some of history's most infamous tales. From East to West, from the UK to Istanbul, join historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and presenter Joe Crowley to investigate subjects that include Rome's famously cruel emperor Caligula and the notoriously violent Vikings. Using re-enactments, revisiting iconic locations and relying upon world-leading experts, can Suzannah and Joe sort fact from myth and rewrite some of history's greatest stories?

name: Feng Zhong You Duo Yu Zuo De Yun
Black Girl in a Big Dress
summary: Black Girl in a Big Dress is a webseries series about an African American Anglophile cosplayer in love with the Victorian Era. Adrienne feels happy and confident when she's dressed up living life like it's a fairy tale, but back in the real world, it's a whole different story.

name: El jardinero
summary: El jardinero tells the story of Elmer and his controlling mother, La China Jurado, who runs a garden centre that hides another thriving underground murder-for-hire business. Killing is easy for Elmer. An accident has left him emotionless. However, while planning the murder of Violet, a charming nursery school teacher, he falls in love with her. Elmer must learn to love while his mother does everything she can to end Violet's life.

name: The Bangkok Boy
summary: After getting released from prison, Sun is filled with anger and sets up an underground gang, the Bangkok Boys. While he expands his power searching for the truth behind the tragic deaths of his nearest and dearest, he falls in love with Peach, a sensitive Korean artist, and unknowingly sets himself up on a path of love and hatred intertwined. A bloodthirsty and heartbreaking urban revenge love story is about to unfold in Bangkok.

name: Escupiré sobre sus tumbas
summary: Determined to avenge his dead brother, Brian goes undercover to exact his plan — but ends up falling for the ambitious cop on the case.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Vinicio hace justicia por el fallecimiento de Sonny

name: Polyfamily
summary: Polyfamily dives deep into the world of polyamory and non-traditional family structures. The show follows two married couples, Alysia & Tyler and Sean & Taya, who have chosen to live together as a closed quad. In this unconventional family set up, Tyler is dating Sean's wife, Taya, and Sean is dating Tyler's wife, Alysia. With four children already and another on the way, the quad is redefining what it means to be a family. A fascinating, vulnerable and unpredictable look at love, loyalty and the complexities of modern family life.

name: High Hoops
summary:
High Hoops tells the story of a charmingly reckless high school basketball player and her chaotic pursuit of success, fame, love and the perfect hook shot.

The show is about a failing school basketball team and the arrival of tall, gaffe-prone but unstoppable Aoife O'Neill. It's a show about determination, finding your tribe, and being true to yourself. Following Aoife and her family as they move to a new area and a new school. She sees this as an opportunity to change her life. Aoife soon discovers that the only place she really fits in is the school basketball team - only they're terrible. Can she turn them around?

name: A Thousand Times for You
summary: The wedding day turns into a nightmare for Chen Zi, the rich heiress, as her fiance betrays her. She goes to a bar to drink away her sorrows and gets into a fight with a thug. He Chuan comes to her rescue like a knight in shining armor. She is instantly smitten. When they cross paths again, she takes the initiative and proposes marriage. But she has no clue that this rugged mechanic has a secret life.

name: Pobal Ráth Chairn
summary: Ráth Chairn is located in the southeast of the Boyne Valley, between Trim and Athboy in County Meath. This Gaeltacht area was founded in 1935, when a courageous group from Connemara moved east to create a better life for themselves. In this series, we will get an insight into what drives this vibrant and creative community, the aspects of life that are most important to them, and how they preserve their traditions in the beautiful Ráth Chairn.

name: Big Burger Battle
summary:
Hosted by award-winning actor and comedian Andrew Phung, viewers can sink their teeth into this beefy competition that gives the beloved burger its moment in the spotlight with non-stop grilling action.

Host Andrew Phung is joined on the judging panel by celebrated chef and restaurateur, Connie DeSousa,and author, Burger Scholar, and TV personality, George Motz. Each episode, the competitors unleash their creativity in three high-stakes challenges. The battle begins with the "Fast Food" challenge, where they must transform a mystery ingredient into a crave-worthy, burger-adjacent dish. Those with the judges' least favourite creations are sent to "Burgatory", forced to sit out the next round.

Next up is "Burger Bucks", where a juicy $5,000 prize is up for grabs. Here, the remaining competitors craft an outside-the-box burger featuring a star ingredient that pushes culinary boundaries.

Finally, in the "Big Burger Elimination" challenge, the chefs exiled to "Burgatory" return for a last shot at redemption. This time, they must create a stunning gourmet burger with a delectable side, knowing that one competitor will be sent home.

Week after week, the pressure mounts until only three chefs remain. In the end, one champion will rise—grilling, smashing, and frying their way to victory to claim a $25,000 cash prize, an all-inclusive tropical vacation for two provided by Sunwing Vacations, and the coveted title of Big Burger Battle Champion!

name: Snow King: From Olympian to Narco
summary:
The series, which draws from the comprehensive investigative reporting of Rolling Stone and the Toronto Star, charts the astonishing journey of Ryan Wedding – a former Olympic snowboarder who is now one of the FBI's Ten Most Wanted fugitives, accused of running a violent, billion-dollar drug empire for Mexico's most notorious cartel. The verité-driven documentary series takes viewers inside the hunt to uncover how Wedding transformed from national hero to alleged cartel boss and international fugitive. 

The Department of State is offering a reward of up to $10 million for information leading to the arrest and/or conviction of Wedding, who is wanted by the FBI for multiple charges, including orchestrating the murders of four people in Ontario, Canada. Since January, the team has been filming across Canada, Mexico, and the U.S., working alongside expert journalists and investigators - including Rolling Stone's Jesse Hyde, the Toronto Star's Calvi Leon and operatives in Mexico - as well as current and former FBI agents and law enforcement officials. Together, they trace Ryan Wedding's shocking transformation from Canadian snowboarding prodigy into alleged drug kingpin. As the hunt for Wedding escalates, SNOW KING incorporates firsthand accounts from the people whose lives have been irrevocably changed by the crimes he and his co-conspirators have been charged with, creating a visceral, story-driven portrait of the international drug trade – and its devastating human costs.

name: CNBC Sport: On the Record
summary: CNBC Sport: On the Record explores the convergence of sports, business, and investing. Each week, the biggest names in sports - from league commissioners, team owners, influential media executives and top athletes - will give an insider's perspective on the strategies, deals, and stories shaping sports and business.

name: Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series
summary: Building on over 80 years of MLB chronicling the World Series, Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series takes fans deeper than ever before, offering a cinematic, all-access experience. Through exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, raw emotion, and high-stakes drama, the series expands the perspective on baseball's biggest stage, bringing audiences closer than ever to America's favorite pastime and the relentless pursuit of its ultimate prize. With unprecedented access to stars like Freddie Freeman, Mookie Betts, and Aaron Judge, the series captures the intensity of the game from the dugout to the clubhouse, offering a rare, unfiltered look at what it takes to compete at the highest level.

name: Case x Decoded
summary: Chinese Hong Kong averages 34 homicides per year, among which are sensational cases that have shocked the world. This drama presents multiple Chinese Hong Kong suspenseful mystery cases adapted from true events, including the Caesarean Baby Theft Case, the Doll Corpse Hidden Case, and more. The timeline of this drama unfolds sequentially across several cases, showcasing the process of solving each crime. Police Inspector Du Kaibin and female officer Yan Zhuoying become estranged due to a cold case. During an investigation into another unsolved case, the two reconcile their differences. Through repeated collaborations on various cases, their relationship grows into a bond of comradeship, fighting side by side. As their identities, mindsets, and life circumstances continuously evolve, the one thing that never changes is their unwavering determination to seek justice for the victims.

name: The Impressionable Jon Culshaw
summary: Jon Culshaw stars in this satirical sketch show.

name: In My Prime
summary:
In the early 1980s, in the small town of Qingwu, the Qi and Cao families with vastly different family dynamics each welcome a new baby: Qi Shi and Cao Xin. Qi Shi, who suffers from albinism, is acutely aware of her difference from a young age, resorting to drinking soy sauce and wearing wigs in a desperate attempt to fit in. Meanwhile, Cao Xin is the quintessential perfect child in other parents' eyes—yet his reputation comes at the cost of his father's harsh demands. When the unconventional, brave, and stubborn girl crosses paths with the well-behaved, disciplined, and high-achieving boy, the two families—already close neighbors—find their lives intertwined through an absurd swapped-at-birth incident. This sparks a journey filled with tears and the chance for rebirth. As the younglings navigate the trials of family, friendship, and romance, the grown-ups grapple with their career, marriage, and family life. In the torrent of time filled with ups and downs, they heal and grow hand in hand, striving to find their calling and true happiness.
"In My Prime" is a period family drama series adapted from Han Shisan's novel "Close Neighbors (Jin Lin)."

name: My Boyfriend
summary: The domineering CEO, Yi Ning, must marry in order to inherit her family business. Thus, she chooses a "supportive husband" — the charming private chef, Shen Qianze to start a contract marriage. Following their role reversal, Yi Ning finds herself falling for him. However, little does she know that Shen Qianze harbors a shocking secret. As he deliberately draws closer, she unknowingly surrenders to his love...

name: Blossoms of Power
summary: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

name: Game of True Love
summary: Xu Nuo, the pampered heiress of Yuanfei Group, returns home after studying abroad only to find her family in ruins: her mother cast out penniless, her adopted brother Shen Jiahe ready to seize her inheritance, and her father's fiancée turns out to be Bai Xia—her longtime rival and Shen's scandal-ridden ex. Seeing through Shen's schemes, Xu Nuo carefully plots her revenge, luring him into a high-stakes "Game of True Love," a dangerous dance between passion and rivalry.

name: Al-Ashi Street
summary: Riyadh, 1970. Aziza reminisces about her youth as she, her sister Awatif, and the fierce Bedouin Wadha navigate battles of love, ambition, and defiance in a drastically shifting society.

name: 100 Cameras
summary: Each episode of this documentary series focuses on a different place of interest. One hundred cameras are installed and left to record, showcasing the habits and behavior of the people they capture. Without the presence of a camera crew, the subjects gradually begin to share glimpses into their lives, and we receive an unobstructed window into personal conversations and real-life events.

name: Analogue Nostalgia
summary: This is a drama showing the attractiveness of analogue tools or devices. We show now and then.

name: Anime Sanctuaries
summary: Did you know that a lot of your favorite anime are based in real-life locations? Join us on a pilgrimage around Japan to the "Sanctuaries" that are the inspiration of some of the greatest anime!

name: Artists Against War
summary: What can artists do in time of war? This series conveys messages from Japanese artists in various fields in relation to war in the current world.

name: BUDO Secrets
summary: Japan's legendary martial arts―Budo. Their origins can be traced to the warrior traditions of the samurai. These martial arts have endured, existing in various forms to this day.

name: Digital Eye
summary: Digital Eye is an investigative journalism program making full use of geospatial and open source data to seek the truth behind important social issues. The program will use satellite images, social-media analysis and other advanced investigative tools to take an in-depth look at issues.

previousepisode.name: The Hunt for the Dark Fleets

name: Trust No One
summary: Trust No One is a high-stakes thriller about leadership, how lonely it gets at the top, and the death of privacy. The youngest-ever director of the most powerful intelligence agency in Israel, Itamar has forged a career recruiting and handling well-connected informants. Now Itamar is facing the crisis of his life: a cyber security leak is exposing the Israeli Security Agency's (ISA) top-secret agents one by one - starting with Shuruk, daughter of a Hamas leader who he recruited to spy on her own father when she was just 17 years old. Itamar turns to his protégé Yali, a cyber security genius who turned her back on the ISA. Recently released from prison, Yali agrees to help but quickly discovers she's being framed as the source of the leaks. As the leaks continue and more lives are threatened, Itamar does everything to protect his exposed operatives in a race against time. As they close in on the truth together, Itamar's family becomes entangled, forcing him to choose between them, the lives of his operatives, and the career he loves.

previousepisode.name: So Long, Ryoma! To the Town That'll Be Called Tokyo

name: Debut's Plan
summary: Keep watching Debut's Plan and SAVE your favorite NewKids to reach the final debut evaluation.

name: Без башни
summary:
There are 9 characters in the program, each with a bright personality. They all go out into the city to carry out their special mission. They provoke, argue, misbehave... In general, they use all possible means to bring out various emotions in unsuspecting people on the street.

At this time, a hidden camera is watching them - the resulting stories are watched in the studio by viewers, the host of the show Dominic Joker and a jury consisting of three show business stars. The author and participant of the most reckless story becomes the winner, he is awarded a prize - an Oscar statuette without brains.

name: Ч.Т.Д. с Маргаритой Симоньян
summary: Documentary project by Margarita Simonyan "Ch.T.D." On the eve of the 80th anniversary of the Victory in the Great Patriotic War, the author and presenter will talk about the events of that terrible war through the prism of individual historical figures. For example, Margarita will tell about the fate and history of the legendary pilot Alexei Maresyev, the famous front-line correspondent and writer Boris Polevoy, how the famous female bomber aviation regiment "Night Witches" was formed and operated during the war, as well as how the main song of the war years, "Sacred War," was written, how one of the most famous underground anti-fascist organizations was created, consisting of young people, yesterday's schoolchildren, who became the prototype for the "Soldier-Liberator" monument in Treptower Park and much more. Each episode of the documentary project will use quotes from films, books and documents, biographies and memoirs of participants in the events.

previousepisode.name: Из огромной страны — в великую державу: процветание России при Александре III

name: 100 великих
summary: 100 великих is the first documentary series about all the legacies of humanity: from Gagarin's speech to the invention of the wheel, from the statue of David to gene technology, from Maradona's goal to the battle for Sevastopol. Everything that has changed and continues to change our lives, watch in the series "100 Greats".

name: Cimetière indien
summary: In 1995, an ambitious young recruit in an anti-terrorism unit is sent to Peranne to investigate the killing of an imam alongside Jean, a disillusioned gendarme haunted by his memories of the Algerian War.

name: The goal AMIA
summary: Diego, a Mossad agent whose sister was killed in the Argentina terrorist attack, takes a leave of absence and hooks up with Gisela, a local journalist to find those responsible. Their journey to uncover the truth draws them into a world of espionage, intelligence agencies and arms dealers. A dubious world in which lies are truths, and justice and revenge become indistinguishable. The journey that the two embark on will eventually lead to a re-examination of their connection with their families and even their concept of self-identity.

name: Secret Files of XSA
summary: The "Azure-1" project, a globally high-profile scientific research, becomes the target of sabotage by the foreign spy agency SAD. Shura controlled by Gapung seeks to steal the project's core technology. National security officer Huo Min and his team foil the plot planned by SAD, see through Shura's infiltration strategy, and ultimately bright the moles and spies to justice.

name: The Westies
summary: The Westies takes place during the construction of the Jacob Javitz Convention Center on the Westies' home turf in Hell's Kitchen, which promises a financial windfall. Despite being outnumbered fifty-to-one by the Five Families of the Italian Mafia, the Westies' legendary brutality and cunning have given them the leverage necessary to share the spoils through a fragile détente. But internal conflict between the brash younger generation and the old-school leadership threatens to set a match to this powder keg, which will sweep the Westies into the FBI's ever-deepening investigation into the Italian mafia.

name: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
summary: In Eternal Nations, a fantasy strategy game where players manage an empire, Takuto Ira is a legendary player who sits atop the leaderboard. Takuto goes unconscious during a hospitalization and awakens on the continent of Idoragya, which looks just like the game. Takuto meets Sludge Atou, his favorite unit in the game, and decides to build Mynoghra, an evil empire, in this isekai apocalypse anime.

previousepisode.name: Then the Game of the Gods Begins

name: Private Eyes West Coast
summary: Private investigators Matt Shade and Angie Everett have left behind their P.I. firm and settled into a new life on the west coast — but their new quiet life is shaken when a night out lands them at the scene of a murder. A woman stands over her dead boyfriend with a bloody steak knife in hand. Believing in her innocence, Shade and Angie dive headfirst back into the high stakes world of investigation. The private eyes juggle the challenges of opening a P.I. firm in a new city, and without their friendly Toronto network of sources, Shade and Angie work to build a new community. From tracking down a missing student in the wilderness of British Columbia to extracting a murder confession from a surfer in Tofino, Shade and Angie prove life on the west coast is packed with heart-pounding thrills.

name: La Favorita 1922
summary: Madrid 1920s, Marquise Elena de Valmonte explores her passion for cooking, as a means for evading her authoritarian husband. An incident makes her and maid Cecilia fugitives. They reopen an abandoned restaurant as 'La Favorita Bistro'.

name: Sweetheart Service
summary: Fresh graduate Yooha struggles to find a job and takes on gig work to become independent. Meanwhile, workaholic Minwoo, tired of marriage pressure, hires a fake boyfriend for a month. Yooha, exhausted from difficult clients, accepts Minwoo's high-paying offer—with three simple rules: secrecy, two meetings per week, and answering calls when needed. Their contract is clear, but as they continue the act, pretend feelings start to feel real.

name: The World's Strangest Mysteries
summary: The strangest unexplained mysteries ever discovered. Including footage of UFO's, mysterious anomalies, paranormal sightings, strange discoveries in space and bizarre case files. An incredible library of rare stories and sightings caught on video.

previousepisode.name: Mysteries in the Sky - Caught on Camera

name: Jailed: Women in Prison
summary:
This new series provides a rare look into two of Scotland's prisons which house women - HMP and YOI Grampian in Peterhead which has 50 prisoners and HMP & YOI Stirling which operates with up to 117 prisoners

With wide access to both prisons which offers insights into daily prison life, work assignments, and family visits, Jailed: Women in Prison hears from both prisoners and staff and presents the day-to-day realities of life behind bars.

name: Icons of Style
summary:
Delving deep into the social history of Scottish fashion, from Selkirk to Shetland, Icons of Style sees Kirsty Wark explore how Scotland made a big impact on the global fashion scene. Along the way, Kirsty meets the iconic designers, influencers and celebrities who brought catwalk style to international notoriety and championed the country's unique sense of style.

Reflecting on 60 years of Scottish fashion and an enduring influence on the world's fashion stage Kirsty Wark meets the Scots who shaped the industry through the decades and highlights its enduring appeal.

name: День секретных проектов
summary: Global conspiracies, secret research, forbidden predictions and technologies of the future - in special half-hour digest projects from the most knowledgeable presenters of the TV channel. Who wants to feed humanity with mutant meat and oil cabbage? How not to "get hooked" on the cult of consumption? Where do financial pyramids come from in social networks - and is there salvation from them? What is the danger of ... hygiene? How great is the power of hypnosis? How much would car dealership customers save if they paid only for what they really need? What rights does Turkey claim to Antarctica? And when will mushrooms and deep-sea monsters take over the planet?

name: Сделка?!
summary:
"Deal?!" is not only a gambling and surefire game - the player will not return home empty-handed in any case. But also a bright, spectacular, truly exciting show. The growing suspense, the maximum intensity of passions are akin to the emotions of sports fans! TV viewers are involved in the gameplay, from which they can no longer tear themselves away. Not only playing, but also watching the game is an unforgettable pleasure!

The project has gained extraordinary popularity not only in its homeland in the UK, but has also won the hearts of millions of TV viewers around the world. The program is watched in 37 countries, including the Middle East and South America. And everywhere this show shows consistently high ratings. "Deal?!" is a licensed format adapted by the REN TV channel together with the ENDEMOL company (Russia) for Russian TV viewers.

name: Пан или пропал
summary: In the show, anyone can earn 3 million by opening suitcases

name: Семья Зитаров
summary: The events take place at the beginning of the last century, when the revolution had already occurred in Russia, and in bourgeois Latvia it was just beginning. The members of the simple peasant family of the Zithars had a difficult choice: to go with the revolutionaries or to come to terms with the orders of the bourgeois republic.

name: Reservatet
summary: When a neighbor's au pair vanishes from her wealthy suburb, Cecilie seeks answers — and unravels secrets that shatter her seemingly perfect world.

name: De rockstar à tueur: le cas Cantat
summary: In 2003, rock singer Bertrand Cantat killed his partner, actress Marie Trintignant. This documentary revisits the case that divided a nation.

name: Expired
summary: After losing his job, his marriage, and an unbreakable bond with his only daughter, Saleh sees online gambling as his ticket to redemption. But his final bet leads him down a dangerous path that changes his life forever.

name: Потерянная жизнь
summary: Katerina Lavinskaya is the embodiment of a successful and happy life. Owner of a fashionable art gallery, style icon, wife of a famous businessman, expectant mother… It seems that nothing mars this woman's carefree existence, but even those closest to her are unaware that Katerina's past conceals a terrible and dark secret that could destroy her entire life at any moment.

name: The Lady
summary:
The Lady charts the rise and fall of former royal dresser Jane Andrews, whose rags to riches fairy tale fell apart when she was convicted of murder.

Once a young working-class girl from Grimsby, Jane answered an advertisement in the magazine The Lady and to the astonishment of her friends and family, became the Duchess of York's dresser at Buckingham Palace. Moving amongst the highest social circles in Britain, Jane managed to secure a place in the upper-classes, only to lose her job with the Duchess after nine years of service.

Still reeling from her fall from grace, Jane went on to meet charismatic businessman Thomas Cressman and fell deeply in love. Soon cracks began to develop in the romance Jane had pinned all her hopes on, with disastrous consequences.

name: Catch Me at the Ballpark!
summary: A bored office worker's life gets a rom-com curveball when a ballpark beer vendor won't leave his side.

previousepisode.name: Transformative Game / Last Message / It's Opening Day, Okay?!

name: Classic Stars
summary: At Gloria Academy, stars are born! Beethoven trades his gloves for melodies, battling to win the ultimate competition.

name: GUILTY GEAR STRIVE: DUAL RULERS
summary: Sin Kiske, a forbidden hybrid, meets a girl who hates Gears and begins a clash that could upend their magic-driven world!

name: Mono
summary: Follow the local adventures of a photography club in this latest series from the Laid-Back Camp creator!

previousepisode.name: POV Horror - What ever shall we do?

name: The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl
summary: Her blessing: gorilla strength. Her curse: everyone wants it. A timid girl battles to reclaim her quiet life!

previousepisode.name: The Gorilla End Filled with Determination and Love

name: Roaming China with Tang Poetry
summary: This drama follows modern-day woman Chu Ci and the time-traveling poet sage Du Fu on a dreamlike journey. Bound together by fate after an accidental fall into the water, Chu Ci must wait for Du Fu to return to the past before she can regain her freedom. From exploring Chengdu and revisiting the Thatched Cottage to visiting Wuhou Shrine and ascending Mount Emei, their travels lead to a deepening friendship. Along the way, their perspectives on society and life quietly evolve. Through their relentless trials as fated companions, Chu Ci rediscovers her path in life, while Du Fu finds resolution and uncovers his own boundless world and greater truth.

name: Dominion and Devotion
summary: The Ning Dynasty is on the brink. Pei Shenzhi tampers with the testamentary edict and installs Ning Jinyi as a puppet emperor. Ning Jinyi feigns compliance while secretly amassing strength and launching new policies. Pei Shenzhi, drawn to her wit, supports her covertly. Ultimately, she purges the court and rises to be a great empress.

name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
summary:
Set in the future, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon, Leonard and Howard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon.
Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we've come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don't go well.

previousepisode.name: Spoiler: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience

name: Get Hooked
summary: Get Hooked is a 6-part documentary series that explores diverse joy in fishing and nature.

name: Science Fiction in the Atomic Age
summary: This four-part series explores the history of science fiction in the atomic age. It looks at the creation of the atomic bomb by J. Robert Oppenheimer and others, the Cold War, and the many varieties of science fiction expression in all media. Richly illustrated and with a specially written orchestral score, this powerful series will inspire, shock, engage and entertain, with its evocative description of visions of the future expressed in the greatest works of science fiction.

name: Más Fuerte Que Nunca
summary: Más Fuerte Que Nunca will feature exclusive interviews with leading personalities from the entertainment world, content creators, singers, actors, producers, celebrities, and public figures. These guests will share anecdotes and reflections about their careers, personal lives, and experiences beyond the spotlight. María Celeste Arrarás will reveal who's really behind the big names from a more human and sincere perspective.

name: Temptations
summary: To the outside world, the Jordan sisters, Cherish (Keri Hilson) and Roxy (Keshia Chant ) are the hottest singing duo on the charts… but behind closed doors, sibling rivalry runs deep. After returning to their hotel one night, the sisters' penthouse is the target of a frightening jewel heist. Investigators believe the robbery was an inside job and rumors spread that Roxy secretly planned and staged the crime. Will the sisters put aside their lust for the spotlight… or will they let their temptation for fame tear them apart for good?

name: How Can We Help
summary: In How Can We Help newly elected congressman Jimmy Choi causes all kinds of messes for his intrepid staff—none of whom voted for him.

name: Almost Paradise
summary: Almost Paradise focuses on your everyday, normal married couple facing all the everyday, normal challenges of being stranded on a desert Island for decades. Think Blue Lagoon, the family sitcom.

name: Law and the City
summary: A cheerful and passionate youth drama about associate lawyers who go to work at Seocho-dong Law Town every day. It is a realistic story of 'real' lawyers who have stepped into the real world and will portray the coming of age of lawyers in charge of cases that can happen in and around our daily lives. An Ju Hyeong is a 9th-year lawyer with a high level of fact-violence logic. He became a lawyer simply because he found logic and cases interesting. From the beginning, he did not have the 'meaning' that lawyers protect the weak, implement justice, and change the world. He is just a 9th office worker. He has been a regular at the same company for 9 years without changing jobs, and his work is at its peak as his seniority. He is a veteran in the associate industry who has set a new associate salary record but does not open a practice because it is too much trouble. For Ju Hyeong, the peaceful wall of the 'workplace' begins to crack. Kang Hui Ji is a 2nd-year lawyer at Johwa Law Firm. She believes that " if you change one person's life, you have changed that person's world." Whether she is lacking or overflowing, she is confident and honest.

name: Teach You a Lesson
summary: When respect collapses in schools, a special unit arrives to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

name: The Devil's Dinner Party
summary:
Six strangers are shown into a dining room. They're introduced by the host (referred to as "The Devil's Broker"), and have a brief chat over a pre-dinner glass of wine. The contestants then rank each other from favourite down to least favourite, and the person with the worst rank leaves without even sampling the soup.

The remaining five sit down for dinner, and are spotted £1,000 for their prize pool. In turn, each will be asked a question intended to reveal something about themself. For instance, "Who out of four categories of people would you like to live next door to?" The other four pool their brains to predict what answer will be given, and a correct prediction adds £1,000 to the prize pool.

Repeat this so each contestant faces a poser, a process that takes about half an hour.

There's another elimination here, done almost at random. The contenders pick a card at random, one of the cards is marked. That person has to pick their favourite and least favourite contestants, and their least favoured is off the show.

A final question is posed to one contender, where the answer is one of the other three players. There's another £1,000 in the prize fund for a correct answer, bringing the total prize money to a maximum of £7,000.

Who wins this amount? The four remaining players rate each other again, and the contestant with the highest rating takes the money home.

name: Ohnivý kuře
summary: The protagonists Mike and Burák arrive in the small town of Janovy Lázně after a twelve-month stint behind bars to run a pub that Burák inherited from his uncle. Hot on their heels is a pesky probation officer who is waiting for their first step on the edge of the law to send them back behind bars. The pub is in a state of disrepair, however, and gastronomy is out of the question. And so Mike and Burák slowly start to get acquainted with the competition and potential new friends and lovers...

name: Isak og koia – en røverhistorie
summary: Isak Dreyer has one rule of life: crazy ideas MUST be implemented. Like, for example, setting off on a crazy road trip with a hunting lodge in tow.

name: Forget You Not
summary: After multiple crises turn her life upside down, a convenience store clerk discovers a surprising creative outlet to restore her hope: stand-up comedy.

previousepisode.name: If You Forget, I Will Remember It All For You

name: Turning Point: The Vietnam War
summary: This thought-provoking documentary series examines the harrowing consequences of the Vietnam War, from the Gulf of Tonkin incident to the fall of Saigon.

name: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
summary: A dreaded gangster, his menacing aides and a political party with skeletons in its closet — there's a lot for Officer Arjun Maitra to navigate in Bengal.

name: УГРОза: Трепалов и Кошелек
summary: After the Revolution, new people came to power in Russia, but it was too early to talk about a bright future. The enemies were defeated, but a new threat appeared: bandits. Criminals of all stripes felt complete impunity, robbing and killing even during the day. Yakov Koshelnikov's bandits instilled pure terror. They spared no one, and they were nicknamed "Koshelnikov" for their love of other people's property. Only investigator Trepalov dared to challenge the insolent gang. He and his loyal partners intend to catch the villains and punish them to the fullest extent of the law.

name: Porządny człowiek
summary: After his son is beaten by a bully, a family man makes a split-second decision that threatens the course of his idyllic life forever.

name: First to the Finish
summary:
First to the Finish - a New Docuseries Focused on the Relentless Pursuit of the MX-5 Cup Championship - Will Premiere March 25 on Prime Video

From Boardwalk Pictures, First to the Finish follows the journey of two female racers and one female team owner through the exhilarating 2024 Mazda MX-5 Cup Championship Season

name: Le Sens des Choses
summary: Léa, 28, is one of France's first female rabbis: frail shoulders, great responsibilities as she has to find answers in the labyrinth of small and big questions in people's lives. But how can she be a guide for others when she herself is grappling with the fundamentals of love, family and the millennial's quest for meaning?

name: The Diary of Anne Frank
summary: One of the most heart-rending stories of World War II. Forced into hiding, Anne records all in her diary, as her tale of fear, romance and treachery moves to a tragic ending.

name: Kanneda
summary: Against the backdrop of 1990s Toronto, a Punjabi singer's journey from street performer to rising star leads him into dangerous territory.

name: 3 Seconds Later, He Turned Into a Beast
summary: Tsumugi is a female college student who carries trauma from an aggressive man in her past. She meets Kaname at a mixer she requested specifically for unaggressive "herbivore"-type men. She and Kaname hit it off, and Kaname resembles Tsumugi's older brother a little bit, so she relaxes her guard around him. Kaname, however, feigns to be a "herbivore"-type man, but is in reality an aggressive "carnivore"-type man, and he can change his demeanor in an instant.

name: The Witch's Eye
summary: Strange things happen to influencer Han Da Bit from Anyeon University, starting with the nightmare that she has one day. Then one day, she sees Do Hee, a senior she runs into at school, and Da Bit feels a strange attraction. Da Bit, who follows her out of curiosity about Do Hee, enters a unique tarot shop.

previousepisode.name: The fate of two women by the play of God

name: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
summary: Once a loyal court magician supporting the crown prince from behind the scenes, Alec Ygret is cast aside and exiled for only knowing support magic. But just as he hits rock bottom, he reunites with Yorha Eisentz, a former comrade from the legendary party Lasting Period. Invited to rejoin the team that once made history, Alec returns to dungeon exploration—and begins a new chapter in his life!

name: Reclaim
summary: Linen is a woman whose life was shattered after being sexually assaulted and left for dead. When she returns, though, she is no longer a victim. She has the opportunity to reinvent herself as Phrae, a woman determined to take revenge on those who destroyed her, using every means necessary to bring justice to herself.

name: Twelve Dates 'Til Christmas
summary: Talented Saville Row textile pattern designer Kate lives in the quaint village of Blexford, England, next door to her father Mac, who is long-divorced from Kate's mother Delilah, a globe-trotting American always on an adventure.  When not at work, Kate looks after Mac, who's recovering from a motorbike accident and is inclined to spend his days sitting in his recliner.  Unbeknownst to Kate, her best friend Laura signs her up for The 12 Dates of Christmas – a holiday-themed matchmaking program in the days leading up to the holiday featuring carefully curated, yuletide dating experiences, in an attempt to get Kate out of her rut.  Lovingly coerced by Laura and longtime best friend Callum, a reluctant Kate ultimately gets into the spirit of the program and is caught off guard when she meets someone who reinvigorates her zest for life.  But when Delilah unexpectedly shows up on her doorstep – literally – Kate and Mac's life and holiday season get upended.  Meanwhile, Mac may be embarking on his own romance with local Evelyn, a widow who slowly helps him step outside the confines of his house and open his heart.  As Kate wends her way through the 12 dates, she takes a circuitous route to romance while also making some important discoveries about herself.

name: Magic City: An American Fantasy
summary: Magic City has been a legendary Atlanta institution and the launchpad for countless Hip-Hop artists since 1985, leading to the club's reputation as the "Black Studio 54." Now, for the first time, Magic City: An American Fantasy tells the full tale of the storied club's rise to global prominence and how it became the definitive king-maker in the hip-hop community, catering to high-profile celebrities such as 2 Chainz, Nelly, Shaquille O'Neal, Quavo, Killer Mike, Big Boi and others, as well as artists, dancers, and behind-the-scenes players who ensured its iconic status. The series offers an exclusive look into the enigmatic founder, Michael "Mr. Magic" Barney, and the lives of the many women responsible for building the club's mystique.

name: Life or Death: The Negotiators
summary: Dive into the minds of some of the world's most skilled negotiators to understand what it takes to navigate a situation where one wrong move can prove deadly. What secrets can they reveal about the art of negotiation? Analyzing four life-and-death situations, meet the negotiators who have mastered the art of tact in the face of lethal circumstances.

name: Sharp Turns
summary: Tan Yan, deputy publicity chief of Hongye City Police, faces a sudden shift from office to the frontline as political commissar of the SWAT team. A thinker by trade, he is thrown into a world of action and instinct, colliding head-on with Commander Liao Bufan, a seasoned fighter with a big personality. They clash, adapt, and finally join forces to solve a major case. Through the process, Tan Yan rediscovers his true calling as a police officer.

name: Love Casting
summary: To win the lead role in a BL series, eight different men go on a limited summer trip of 7 days and 6 nights, experiencing youthful, passionate, romantic, and heartfelt situations in various attractions. As the eight men get to know each other better through the journey, they take on different "BL script missions" to nurture their feelings and chemistry. In the final confession scene, they must choose each other in order to star in the BL series.

name: Let's Go Luna!
summary: Luna the moon guides three friends -- a wombat, a butterfly and a frog -- as they visit new places around the world with their parents' traveling performance troupe.

name: Большой хит
summary: Music, excitement and laughter! A new TNT show where the stars of show business will guess the hits of all time. Presenters Timur Rodriguez and Regina Todorenko will help the participants go through musical challenges full of humor and unexpected twists. In each issue, participants will compete in guessing songs, overcoming obstacles — from cover bands to children performing hits in their "own" language.

name: Sandokan
summary: Borneo, 1841. Sandokan is a pirate sailing the China Sea with his trusted companion Yanez. An ancient prophecy, his forbidden love for the beautiful Marianna, and the ruthless hunt unleashed by Lord Brooke, a bold English adventurer and in love with the same woman, lead the pirate to make a series of choices that will transform him into the "Tiger of Malaysia."

name: Inside
summary: Ten influencers. One house. One million pounds. All the Insiders have to do is complete the challenges and not blow the cash — easy, right?

name: Xun Jian
summary: Honored Master ordered to go out of the mountains to join the world, to join the family as a son-in-law for the last wish, everyone in the world said that I was incompetent, but who knows, in fact, I am a peerless sword fairy who looks down on the world? let's watch my sword sweep the universe and break through the sky!

name: #Compass 2.0 Animation Project
summary: Rebel hero 13 refuses a partner — until Jin joins him. Can they fight to keep COMPASS2.0 running and bring peace?

name: Heavenly Ever After
summary: Upon arriving in heaven at the age of 80, Hae Sook reunites with her rejuvenated husband, Nak Joon, leading to a romance that transcends their earthly lives.

name: Secrets of the Silent Witch
summary: Monica Everett, the Silent Witch, is the world's only practitioner of Voiceless Magic, a veritable heroine who single-handedly fended off the Black Dragon of legend. However, the young prodigy is actually…super-duper shy! Yup, turns out she only learned Voiceless Magic to avoid speaking in public. Ignorant of this, the Seven Sages have placed her on a top-secret mission to guard the Second Prince. Can Monica keep it together as she contends with both social interaction and the evils targeting the young royal?

name: Gangs of Milano - Le nuove storie del Blocco
summary: In the Blocco, gang clashes see confronting Bea, torn between her role as Segundera and her hope for a normal life, and Mahdi, who tries hard to cover the void left by his uncle. Between them is a gang of brash young boys, the Kasba: multi-ethnic, loud, irrepressible. Leading them are Zak and Nael, two 20-year-olds of Arab descent determined to make their own way, in music as in life. Ludo's return to town, hurt and lost after an event for which he bears the blame, leads Bea, Ludo and Mahdi to come to terms with the bond that each, in his own way, tries to deny. But together they are stronger: so between old friends and new enemies, the pressures of expectations and a life that seems to play with them as if they were pawns, Bea, Ludo and Mahdi unite again in a no-holds-barred adventure.

name: Беспринципные в Питере
summary: Valentina leaves Patriarch's Ponds in search of a better life. New adventures of the brightest heroine of "Unprincipled"

name: Vytoč mého agenta
summary: Call My Agent tells comedic stories from a casting agency. Every day is full of work and human pitfalls. Trying to satisfy the demanding needs of acting stars, a constant battle with competition, complicated personal relationships that often get mixed up in work matters. The agency team has to manage all of this and survive the daily struggle that brings with it many absurd and comical situations, as well as touching moments and real human dramas.

name: Catch Your Luck
summary: A drama depicting the turbulent and eventful growth period of three friends; one rich, one poor, and one who wants to be rich, and their families.

name: Changing Planet
summary: Changing Planet, a 7-year PBS project, follows Dr. M. Sanjayan as he investigates the planet's most vulnerable ecosystems and the urgent efforts to help them survive climate change, revisiting six key habitats and exploring innovative solutions

name: Andre folks penge
summary: A network of bankers, lawyers and mega-rich investors are defrauding European treasuries of EUR146 billion. Two women try to stop it, but the states and the banks are intent on thwarting their efforts.

name: RTÉ Choice Music Prize
summary: Highlights from the announcement of the winning Irish Album of the Year 2024 at the live event in Vicar St.

name: Hey! Fuzzy Yellow
summary:
HEY FUZZY YELLOW is a one of a kind show. It stands out, because it is different.
The show is built around a central theme that is set in the initial narrative part of the show. That part is then followed by individual segments categorized in 4 main blocks: the Arts, Academic Skills, Creative Expression and Social-Emotional Skills.

We want to show the kids watching the show, that there are many different approaches to a subject and every individual will find one that suits his or her talent and interest. Every child has the right to learn to express itself in a way that feels natural and good. HEY FUZZY YELLOW will show them that way and finding that way will help to build self-confidence.

So, all of that, with a sauce of good, honest fun, lots of laughs and craziness, jokes and funny twists. We give you a new star in a new genre, which we like to call: FUNTAINMENT.

The show is unique in so many different ways, just like children are unique in so many different ways.

name: Děcko
summary: One desperate woman and four couples fighting over her unborn child.

name: Limity
summary: An unfortunate mistake turns a conservative businessman into a star of environmentalists. Could this be a sign of a life-changing event?

name: If She Calls It Love
summary: Ima is a single mother with a high school daughter. She has fallen in love again. The other person is Hisame, a graduate student about a decade younger than her. The two are attracted to each other, regardless of their age or circumstances. However, she already has a high school daughter and two other lovers. Ima, who does not feel jealous even if her partner has another lover, has taken the form of a "multiple love" with the consent and understanding of all involved, which is a free relationship but is definitely different from betrayal such as adultery or cheating.

previousepisode.name: If They Call That Love, Too

name: Only joling
summary: In the real-life soap Only Joling, Gerard is followed in the run-up to his 65th birthday and his 40th anniversary in the entertainment world and that is of course accompanied by many hilarious and extravagant moments.

name: Three Person Marriage
summary: One day, Mitsuda Takuzo is approached by his ex-girlfriend, Yanoguchi Mia, and her current boyfriend, Satomura Shinpei, who propose the idea of a "three-person marriage". Initially, Takuzo dismisses the idea as absurd, but he gradually agrees to a one-year trial period of shared living. As they navigate this unconventional arrangement, the trio faces numerous challenges, including setting boundaries for their sexual relationships, managing jealousy, and explaining their situation to their parents. Through it all, they strive to define their own version of happiness.

name: Guddada Bhootha
summary: When a retired farther and his daughter from Mumbai moves into a house in a village rumored to be haunted faces paranormal activities. They must uncover the secret with the help of Sreenivas, a friend of the daughter.

name: Mise hledání lásky
summary: More than a third of people in the Czech Republic are single. A dating probe will reveal the reality of how we in the Czech Republic today are looking for a relationship, partnership, and maybe even love.

name: Marzahn Mon Amour
summary:
Kathi is starting a new chapter in life.Her daughter Lilly is almost grown, and her husband has left. As a pedicurist in a small salon, she meets the people of Marzahn—many of whom go days without real conversation and pour out their hearts the moment they step inside.They cherish every touch, grateful for a place where they feel seen and respected.With each encounter, Kathi rediscovers herself, realizing that happiness is a choice. More and more, she understands that this salon has saved her.

Starring Jördis Triebel, Yvonne Yung Hee Bormann, and Deborah Kaufmann, this six-part miniseries is directed by rising star Clara Zoë My-Linh von Arnim ("Die Zweiflers") and based on the autofictional bestseller by Katja Oskamp.

name: Приворот
summary: Varya's life is like a fairy tale. She does what she loves, working as a pastry chef, and marries Ilya, with whom she dreams of spending her whole life. It seems that nothing and no one can ruin their happiness... But Alina, Varya's older sister, has other plans. Unlike her relative, Alina is unhappy in her marriage, although at first glance it is not noticeable. The envious and insidious woman is ready to do anything to get Varya's husband, even if it means resorting to black magic. However, Ilya's love spell turns into a real nightmare for both families.

name: Исчезнувшая
summary: Dasha gets a job as a housekeeper for a successful restaurant owner, Lydia. The girl quickly gains the trust of the powerful businesswoman, but her appearance in the house has its own reasons. In fact, Dasha is Lydia's sister, about whom she knew nothing, but the heroine is in no hurry to immediately reveal the whole truth. However, family secrets of the past begin to emerge when Lydia disappears. It turns out that Dasha was not the only one who had a motive for revenge on Lydia. But despite everything, only she sincerely wants to find her sister...

name: Makina-san's a Love Bot?!
summary: Makina Agatsuma, the school idol, moves into the home of Eita Akutsu, an introverted mechanical otaku. Eita, who has secretly harbored feelings for her, thinks he's hit the jackpot! But it turns out, she's actually a robot made for sexual purposes. Caught off guard by her sudden physical advances, the virgin Eita is at a loss. Furthermore, he finds himself in a frenzy trying to help her maintain her secret identity. A romantic comedy with a slightly risqué mechanical revelation, where hilarity ensues as they try to keep the secret under wraps!

previousepisode.name: Thus, Makina Does a Naughty Workout

name: A Protegida
summary: In the heart of the Alentejo countryside, Mariana and José Diogo are two children whose backgrounds could not be more different: she is the fruit of a loving relationship; he's an orphan. She has a safe haven in her family to run to when she gets hurt; he can only run to her.

name: Punto Nemo
summary: Members of an oceanographic expedition made up of scientists and the Spanish Navy embark on the Pentonkontors ship to investigate and raise awareness of the problems of the plastic island located in the South Pacific. It's time to get to grips with the situation and the freedom of the planet. It is important to know that your habitation for military personnel is good, so that you can prepare for your habitation and survival so that you can survive your daily life at Point Nemo. A place full of mysteries and lurking dangers.

name: Desert Doc
summary: Desert Doc is a Prime Video series that offers a behind-the-scenes look at Medical Center Hospital, a remote and high-level trauma center in West Texas. The 13-episode series follows Dr. Sudip Bose, a combat veteran and emergency physician, as he and his team navigate challenging medical situations. The series covers topics such as the opioid crisis, oil field accidents, the aftermath of the Odessa mass shooting, and West Texas heat waves.

name: St Patrick's Festival Parade
summary: Sarah McInerney, Dáithí Ó Sé, Emer O'Neill and Thomas Crosse (Crossy) with live coverage from the streets of Dublin.

name: Watari-kun's ****** Is about to Collapse
summary: Naoto Watari lives solely for his little sister, Suzushiro, until his chaotic childhood friend, Satsuki, storms back into his life. Without uttering a single word, her very presence ignites buried memories and unravels his rigid routine. As tensions rise and secrets surface, Naoto's devotion to Suzushiro clashes with unresolved pain, threatening to collapse his fragile world.

previousepisode.name: One Last Thing to Make Sure Of

name: Tabloid
summary: Senior entertainment journalist Liu Chih Chun learns that her colleague Lin Pei Ting, a junior journalist, died at a sex and drug-fuelled party. Consequently, the reputation of the weekly magazine she works for is seriously damaged. As Lin's supervisor, Chih Chun has to uncover the mystery that lies beneath Lin's death and use the scoop to save her career. With the notebook Lin left behind, Chih Chun retraces Lin's steps realizing that Lin posed as a prostitute to secretly investigate the sex scandals in the entertainment business and that the news is just the tip of the iceberg. Balanced between truth and survival, Liu Chih Chun is determined to reveal the truth where danger awaits.

name: Adikts
summary: Max, Mell, Ema, Robin and Sonia. As part of a responsible approach to their studies, five addictionology students decide on an experiment - to take drugs that could temporarily solve the problems of each of them. As Professor Jensen says, drugs are shortcuts to solving problems. But the experiment has one significant catch. The effect of the drugs will become permanent for everyone. Fun and newly acquired "superpowers" lead the young heroes to the edge of their possibilities, but also of their strength. And all this in a situation where the function of a drug coordinator has been established in the country, which approaches the drug problem with maximum severity...

name: Donal's Festival Kitchen
summary: Donal Skehan is joined by chefs and special guests as they explore the vibrant flavours of various celebrations.

name: Hooked: How Addiction Hijacks Your Brain
summary: This gripping three-part documentary dives deep into the science of addiction and recovery - whether it's phones, alcohol, gambling, or hard drugs.

name: Con Esa Misma Mirada
summary: After 25 years of marriage, Eloísa discovers her husband's infidelity with a younger man and decides to separate. Her unexpected loneliness forces her to question herself and find the courage to rediscover love.

name: La CQ: nuevo ingreso
summary: A new school year starts at Constantino Quijano High School, where a new generation on of students is ready to create unforgettable moments. Sofi, the confident cheerleading captain, has sworn off dating after her breakup with Alan, the football team's star player. But her resolve is tested with the arrival of Quique—a charming new student with a bold dream. Quique is determined to conquer his stage fright and pursue acting, hoping to impress the father he's never met, a renowned singer. Through thrilling adventures, friendships, and unexpected twists, the students of La CQ discover that at this high school, the possibilities are as limitless as their imaginations.

previousepisode.name: El regreso del fantasma del casillero 13 (2)

name: Sakura Tsuushin
summary:
A Keio University (one of the top three colleges in Japan) exam candidate, Touma Inaba, is interupted when a cute young girl, Urara Kasuga, arrives at his hotel room door. She later turns out to be his cousin who he barely remembers from his childhood. Urara, who had felt something special for him (an other-than-cousinly-love), invites Touma to live with her since he has no place to stay other than the hotel room. Before taking the test, Touma meets Meiko Yotsuba, a beautiful, sophisticated woman also trying to get into Keio. Meiko gets into Keio but Touma does not, due to a cold Urara had given him shortly before. Although he did not make it, he pretends he does to earn the respect of Meiko. Touma is caught up in a love triangle with Urara and Meiko, while struggling to keep Meiko believing he's really a Keio student and still be there for Urara at the same time.

This is OVA adaptation of the manga, initially released on 6 VHS cassettes.

name: Claire Hooper's House of Games
summary:
Hosted by one of Australia's favourite stand-up comedians Claire Hooper, the play along at home quiz show will see four celebrity players battle it out each week to test their skills in an entertaining series of trivia-based puzzles, riddles and brain teasers.  

Each Monday to Friday night, four competing celebrities will back it up as Claire dishes out a different mix of head-scratching games all designed to fuel the celebrity players' competitiveness and test their mental prowess.

Stepping up to the podium is an eclectic mix of famous faces, including Olympic swimmer Emily Seebohm, television personality Jamie Durie, celebrity cook Julie Goodwin, ABC presenter favourites Costa Georgiadis and Zan Rowe, actor and performer Eddie Perfect and comedians Lizzy Hoo, Rhys Nicholson, Nazeem Hussain and Geraldine Hickey.

Following a quick-fire round, a nightly winner is declared each episode, awarding them bragging rights and their pick of the kitsch-inspired ‘House of Games' merchandise. Who wouldn't want to walk away with their very own ‘must-have' salad spinner or fun fondue set?

At the end of the week points are then tallied and an overall weekly winner will be crowned champion and awarded the highly coveted ‘House of Games' trophy. 

Fun, witty and full of surprises, Claire Hooper's House of Games is a limited series game show where the quiz is king, but the game will make you grin.

name: Necronomico no Cosmic Horror Show
summary: Miko Kurono, also known as Necronomico, graduates from middle school and decides to pursue her dreams of becoming a streamer. One day, as she's with her childhood friend, Mayu Mayusaka, and her rival, Kanna Kagurasaka, she accepts an offer to play a new VR game. The game gives Miko the opportunity to take on mysterious challenges with other unique streamers she meets within the VR world.

name: Stezka Českem
summary: Travel documentaries about the new subculture of "trailwalkers", personal freedom, landscape, history, people, meeting, Mirek Vladyka will present the northern route of the unique Czech Trail.

name: Kauza Kramný
summary: Kauza Kramný focuses on the case of Petr Kramný, convicted of murdering his wife and daughter during a vacation in Egypt in 2013. After more than ten years we show the fates of people whose lives were changed by this case.

name: Praha ožralá
summary: A quirky guide to Prague's pubs, bars and taverns based on the bestseller by Radim Kopác and Petr Stancík.

name: Game Story
summary: Stories of the creation of the most important Czech games that have shaped generations of fans. A documentary series about computer games and game developers from the late 1980s to the present.

name: Případ Stodolovi
summary: 8 murders, 2 attempted murders, 2 robberies

name: Technické klenoty
summary: There are many unique technical monuments in our country, the significance of which transcends borders and time. Industrial heritage is conducted by Miroslav Táborský. We will see expeditions to attractions from mining, military and other interesting fields.

name: To se vysvětlí, soudruzi!
summary: Eight cases for the Authority for the paranormal phenomena

name: Vlastně se nic nestalo
summary: Zofie and Andrea offer paid content on adult platforms. While Zofie tries to rebuild her damaged self-esteem after breaking up with Roman and experiment with these platforms, Andrea longs for financial freedom which moves her from her original goal of making a living by serious modeling. Zofie sees adult platforms as a kind of emancipation tool, while financial situation and demands of fans drive once famous Andrea deeper into darker waters of sex influencership.

name: Lež na pláži
summary: The owners of a successful IT start-up, Hynek, Gabriel and Stepan, threaten the interests of a dangerous mobster and have to flee Prague. On the run, they find asylum in a hotel where they pose as bartenders under false identities.

name: Policie Hvar
summary: Even in holiday paradise, sometimes things go wrong. And sometimes they kill.

name: Mozaika
summary: The story of a family, which is shaken by the sudden separation of the parents. They decide to find themselves, but each separately. Before that, they have to find a new homes, so they temporarily travel to the families of their children.

name: Krematorium
summary: The story of the Záhorský family and their family crematorium. One would think that it would be quite dead in such an enterprise, but strange, mysterious (and it must be said, very funny) events begin to happen to the Záhorskys, which cross the line of life, death, and above all black humor.
